# Cluster-rate coefficient-of-variation approximation
# Field Trials of Health Interventions, Chapter 5, Section 6.1
# With additive one-cluster correction

# Input parameters
treatment_rate <- 0.005        # per child-week
control_rate <- 0.010          # per child-week
exposure_per_cluster <- 2500   # child-weeks per cluster
cv <- 0.25                     # between-cluster coefficient of variation
alpha <- 0.05                  # significance level, two-sided
target_power <- 0.90           # target power
allocation_ratio <- 1          # equal allocation (1:1)

# Two-sided test critical value
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)

# Power critical value
z_power <- qnorm(target_power)

# Rate difference (H0: lambda_t = lambda_c)
lambda_t <- treatment_rate
lambda_c <- control_rate
delta <- lambda_t - lambda_c

cat("Input Parameters:\n")
cat("Treatment rate (λ_t):", lambda_t, "per child-week\n")
cat("Control rate (λ_c):", lambda_c, "per child-week\n")
cat("Rate difference (δ):", delta, "per child-week\n")
cat("Between-cluster CV:", cv, "\n")
cat("Exposure per cluster:", exposure_per_cluster, "child-weeks\n")
cat("Significance level (two-sided):", alpha, "\n")
cat("Target power:", target_power, "\n")
cat("z_α/2:", z_alpha, "\n")
cat("z_power:", z_power, "\n\n")

# Under H0, both arms have rate λ_c (null hypothesis of no difference)
# Expected number of events per cluster under H0
m0 <- exposure_per_cluster * lambda_c

# Under H1, treatment arm has rate λ_t, control arm has rate λ_c
m_t <- exposure_per_cluster * lambda_t  # expected events in treatment arm
m_c <- exposure_per_cluster * lambda_c  # expected events in control arm

cat("Expected events per cluster under H0 (both arms):", m0, "\n")
cat("Expected events in treatment cluster:", m_t, "\n")
cat("Expected events in control cluster:", m_c, "\n\n")

# Variance inflation factor due to between-cluster variation
# var = E[m] * (1 + CV²) where var is cluster-level variance
inflation_factor <- 1 + cv^2

cat("Variance inflation factor (1 + CV²):", inflation_factor, "\n\n")

# Cluster-level variance under H0 (null)
# For Poisson with overdispersion: var = m * (1 + CV²)
var_null <- m0 * inflation_factor

# Cluster-level variance under H1 (alternative)
# var_t = m_t * (1 + CV²)
# var_c = m_c * (1 + CV²)
var_treatment <- m_t * inflation_factor
var_control <- m_c * inflation_factor

# For two-sided test, pooled variance (assuming equal allocation)
var_pooled_h1 <- (var_treatment + var_control) / 2

cat("Variance under H0 (both arms):", var_null, "\n")
cat("Variance in treatment arm under H1:", var_treatment, "\n")
cat("Variance in control arm under H1:", var_control, "\n")
cat("Pooled variance under H1:", var_pooled_h1, "\n\n")

# Expected rate difference: δ = λ_t - λ_c
expected_delta <- lambda_t - lambda_c

# For cluster-level analysis, the expected difference per cluster is:
expected_cluster_difference <- exposure_per_cluster * expected_delta

cat("Expected cluster-level rate difference:", expected_delta, "per child-week\n")
cat("Expected event difference per cluster:", expected_cluster_difference, "\n\n")

# Number of clusters per arm (before rounding and correction)
# Using two-sample z-test for difference of means formula:
# n = (z_α/2 + z_β)² * (var_null / (treatment_effect)²)
# 
# However, for cluster-level analysis with overdispersion:
# The variance structure is more complex. The standard formula for 
# cluster-randomized trials is:
#
# n_k = [(z_α/2 + z_β)² * σ²] / effect²
#
# where effect is cluster-level rate difference
# σ² is the pooled variance

# Under the CV approximation, we use:
# var of difference = var_treatment + var_control (for independent clusters)
# For each arm: variance of (λ̂_t - λ̂_c) needs the sum of variances
# 
# Standard two-sample cluster-level formula:
# n_k = [(z_α/2 + z_β)² * (var_t + var_c)] / (effect²)
#
# where effect = m_t - m_c (cluster-level difference)

effect_cluster <- m_t - m_c  # difference in expected events per cluster
effect_cluster_rate <- expected_delta  # difference in rates

cat("Effect (cluster event difference):", effect_cluster, "\n")
cat("Effect (rate difference):", effect_cluster_rate, "per child-week\n\n")

# Sample size calculation
# For testing difference in Poisson rates with cluster structure:
# n_k = (z_α/2 + z_β)² * (var_null * 2) / (effect²)
# 
# With variance inflation and equal allocation:
n_k_formula <- (z_alpha + z_power)^2 * (var_treatment + var_control) / (effect_cluster^2)

cat("Sample size formula calculation:\n")
cat("  Numerator: (z_α/2 + z_β)² * (var_t + var_c)\n")
cat("           = (", z_alpha, "+", z_power, ")² * (", var_treatment, "+", var_control, ")\n")
cat("           = ", (z_alpha + z_power)^2, "* ", (var_treatment + var_control), "\n")
cat("           = ", (z_alpha + z_power)^2 * (var_treatment + var_control), "\n")
cat("  Denominator: effect² = ", effect_cluster, "² =", effect_cluster^2, "\n")
cat("  n_k (continuous) = ", n_k_formula, "\n\n")

# Additive one-cluster correction
# Add 1 cluster to each arm for conservative coverage
n_k_continuous <- n_k_formula
n_k_rounded <- ceiling(n_k_continuous)
n_k_with_correction <- n_k_rounded + 1

cat("Rounding and correction:\n")
cat("  n_k continuous =", n_k_continuous, "\n")
cat("  n_k rounded up =", n_k_rounded, "\n")
cat("  n_k with one-cluster correction = ", n_k_rounded, "+ 1 =", n_k_with_correction, "\n\n")

# Verification: calculate achieved power at final sample size
# Power = P(Z > z_crit | H1), where Z is test statistic under H1

# Test statistic: Z = (λ̂_t - λ̂_c) / SE(λ̂_t - λ̂_c)
# Under H1 (with n_k clusters per arm):
# E[λ̂_t] = λ_t, E[λ̂_c] = λ_c
# Var[λ̂_t] = var_treatment / n_k
# Var[λ̂_c] = var_control / n_k
# SE² = var_treatment/n_k + var_control/n_k

se_squared_h1 <- (var_treatment + var_control) / n_k_with_correction
se_h1 <- sqrt(se_squared_h1)

# Non-centrality parameter
ncp <- (m_t - m_c) / se_h1

# Achieved power
achieved_power <- pnorm(ncp - z_alpha) + pnorm(-ncp - z_alpha)
# For one-sided upper tail (or two-sided):
achieved_power_twosided <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha - ncp) + pnorm(-z_alpha - ncp)
achieved_power_twosided_correct <- pnorm(ncp - z_alpha) + pnorm(-ncp - z_alpha)

# More directly for two-sided:
# P(|Z| > z_α/2) under H1 = 1 - Φ(z_α/2 - ncp) + Φ(-z_α/2 - ncp)
# = Φ(ncp - z_α/2) + Φ(-z_α/2 - ncp)
# ≈ Φ(ncp - z_α/2) for large ncp

achieved_power <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha - ncp)

cat("Verification at n_k =", n_k_with_correction, "clusters per arm:\n")
cat("  SE under H1:", se_h1, "\n")
cat("  Effect size (cluster events):", m_t - m_c, "\n")
cat("  Non-centrality parameter:", ncp, "\n")
cat("  Achieved power (two-sided):", achieved_power, "\n")
cat("  Target power:", target_power, "\n\n")

# Also verify at the rounded but uncorrected sample size
se_squared_h1_rounded <- (var_treatment + var_control) / n_k_rounded
se_h1_rounded <- sqrt(se_squared_h1_rounded)
ncp_rounded <- (m_t - m_c) / se_h1_rounded
achieved_power_rounded <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha - ncp_rounded)

cat("Verification at n_k =", n_k_rounded, "clusters per arm (before correction):\n")
cat("  Achieved power (two-sided):", achieved_power_rounded, "\n\n")

# Final result
cat("=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "\n")
cat("FINAL RESULT\n")
cat("=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "\n")
cat("Sample size (clusters per arm):", n_k_with_correction, "\n")
cat("Method: cluster_rate_cv with additive one-cluster correction\n")
cat("Achieved power at n_k =", n_k_with_correction, ":", achieved_power, "\n")
cat("Power at n_k =", n_k_rounded, ":", achieved_power_rounded, "\n")

# JSON result for structured reporting
results <- list(
  sample_size = n_k_with_correction,
  sample_size_unit = "clusters_per_arm",
  method = "cluster_rate_cv",
  achieved_power = achieved_power,
  power_at_preceding_design = achieved_power_rounded,
  preceding_design_sample_size = n_k_rounded
)

cat("\nStructured result:\n")
print(jsonlite::toJSON(results, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))

# Output for POWER_AGENT_RESULT
library(jsonlite)
output <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = n_k_with_correction, unit = "clusters_per_arm"),
    list(metric = "achieved_power", value = round(achieved_power, 6), unit = "proportion"),
    list(metric = "power_at_preceding_design", value = round(achieved_power_rounded, 6), unit = "proportion")
  )
)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=" %+% jsonlite::toJSON(output, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))

allocation_ratio <- 1          # equal allocation (1:1)

# Two-sided test critical value

# Power critical value
z_power <- qnorm(target_power)

lambda_c <- control_rate

cat("Input Parameters:\n")
cat("Treatment rate (lambda_t):", lambda_t, "per child-week\n")
cat("Control rate (lambda_c):", lambda_c, "per child-week\n")
cat("Rate difference (delta):", delta, "per child-week\n")
cat("Between-cluster CV:", cv, "\n")
cat("Exposure per cluster:", exposure_per_cluster, "child-weeks\n")
cat("Significance level (two-sided):", alpha, "\n")

m_t <- exposure_per_cluster * lambda_t  # treatment cluster

cat("Expected events per cluster:\n")
cat("  Treatment:", m_t, "\n")
cat("  Control:", m_c, "\n\n")

# Variance inflation factor due to between-cluster variation
inflation_factor <- 1 + cv^2

cat("Variance inflation factor (1 + CV^2):", inflation_factor, "\n\n")

# For cluster-level analysis of rates, the variance of a rate estimate
# from a single cluster is approximately:
# Var(lambda_hat) = lambda * (1 + CV^2) / exposure
# 
# When comparing two independent clusters (one from each arm):
# Var(lambda_t_hat - lambda_c_hat) = [lambda_t*(1+CV^2) + lambda_c*(1+CV^2)] / exposure
#                                   = (lambda_t + lambda_c) * (1 + CV^2) / exposure
#
# For n_k clusters per arm, the variance of cluster averages becomes:
# Var(bar_lambda_t - bar_lambda_c) = [lambda_t*(1+CV^2) + lambda_c*(1+CV^2)] / (n_k * exposure)
#                                   = (lambda_t + lambda_c) * (1 + CV^2) / (n_k * exposure)

# The rate difference effect size
rate_effect <- lambda_t - lambda_c

var_rate_difference <- (lambda_t + lambda_c) * inflation_factor

cat("Variance of rate difference (per cluster pair):\n")

cat("  = (", lambda_t, "+", lambda_c, ") *", inflation_factor, "\n")

#
# n_k = [(z_alpha/2 + z_beta)^2 * var_rate_difference] / (rate_effect^2 * exposure)
#

# - Rate difference scaled by exposure

# Var(bar_lambda) = lambda * (1 + CV^2) / (n_k * exposure)

#
# n_k = [(z_alpha/2 + z_beta)^2 * (lambda_t + lambda_c) * (1+CV^2)] / [(lambda_t - lambda_c)^2 * exposure]

cat("Sample size formula:\n")
cat("  n_k = [(z_alpha/2 + z_beta)^2 * (lambda_t + lambda_c) * (1+CV^2)] / [(lambda_t - lambda_c)^2 * exposure]\n")
cat("  n_k = [(", z_alpha, "+", z_power, ")^2 * (", lambda_t, "+", lambda_c, ") * ", 
    inflation_factor, "] / [(", rate_effect, ")^2 * ", exposure_per_cluster, "]\n")

    inflation_factor, "] / [", rate_effect^2, "* ", exposure_per_cluster, "]\n")
cat("  n_k = [", (z_alpha + z_power)^2 * (lambda_t + lambda_c) * inflation_factor, "] / ", 
    rate_effect^2 * exposure_per_cluster, "\n")
cat("  n_k (continuous) =", n_k_formula, "\n\n")

n_k_rounded <- ceiling(n_k_formula)
n_k_with_correction <- n_k_rounded + 1

cat("Rounding and correction:\n")
cat("  n_k continuous =", n_k_formula, "\n")
cat("  n_k rounded up =", n_k_rounded, "\n")
cat("  n_k with one-cluster correction =", n_k_rounded, "+ 1 =", n_k_with_correction, "\n\n")

# Standard error at H1 with n_k clusters per arm

# Correct two-sided: 1 - pnorm(z_crit - |ncp|) when |ncp| > z_crit
achieved_power <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha - abs(z_effect))

cat("Verification at n_k =", n_k_with_correction, "clusters per arm:\n")
cat("  SE(rate_diff):", se_rate_diff, "\n")
cat("  Z-effect (|lambda_t - lambda_c| / SE):", z_effect, "\n")

cat("Verification at n_k =", n_k_rounded, "clusters per arm (before correction):\n")
cat("  Achieved power (two-sided):", achieved_power_rounded, "\n\n")

cat("=====================================\n")
cat("FINAL RESULT\n")
cat("=====================================\n")
cat("Sample size (clusters per arm):", n_k_with_correction, "\n")
cat("Method: cluster_rate_cv with additive one-cluster correction\n")
cat("Achieved power at n_k =", n_k_with_correction, ":", achieved_power, "\n")
cat("Power at n_k =", n_k_rounded, ":", achieved_power_rounded, "\n")

# Output for POWER_AGENT_RESULT
library(jsonlite)
output <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = n_k_with_correction, unit = "clusters_per_arm"),
    list(metric = "achieved_power", value = round(achieved_power, 6), unit = "proportion"),
    list(metric = "power_at_preceding_design", value = round(achieved_power_rounded, 6), unit = "proportion")
  )
)

# Detailed documentation and verification of the cluster-rate CV approximation
# Field Trials of Health Interventions, Chapter 5, Section 6.1

cat("CLUSTER-RATE COEFFICIENT-OF-VARIATION APPROXIMATION\n")
cat("From: Field Trials of Health Interventions, Chapter 5, Section 6.1\n")
cat("With: Additive one-cluster correction\n\n")

cat("METHODOLOGY:\n")
cat("=============\n\n")

cat("1. RATE OUTCOMES IN CLUSTERS\n")
cat("   - Each cluster has exposure E (in child-weeks)\n")
cat("   - Event rate lambda is observed with overdispersion relative to Poisson\n")
cat("   - Between-cluster variation captured via coefficient of variation CV\n\n")

cat("2. VARIANCE STRUCTURE FOR RATE ESTIMATION\n")
cat("   For a single cluster, the variance of the rate estimator is:\n")
cat("   Var(lambda_hat) = lambda * (1 + CV^2) / exposure\n")
cat("   where (1 + CV^2) accounts for extra-Poisson variation\n\n")

cat("3. TWO-ARM RATE DIFFERENCE\n")
cat("   For treatment vs. control (independent cluster samples):\n")
cat("   Var(lambda_t_hat - lambda_c_hat) [single cluster each]\n")
cat("   = [lambda_t + lambda_c] * (1 + CV^2) / exposure\n\n")

cat("4. CLUSTER-AVERAGED RATE DIFFERENCE\n")
cat("   With n_k clusters per arm, averaging cluster estimates:\n")
cat("   SE(lambda_t_bar - lambda_c_bar) = sqrt{[lambda_t + lambda_c] * (1 + CV^2) / (n_k * exposure)}\n\n")

cat("5. SAMPLE SIZE FORMULA (from standard two-sample rate difference)\n")
cat("   n_k = [(z_{alpha/2} + z_beta)^2 * (lambda_t + lambda_c) * (1 + CV^2)] / \n")
cat("         [(lambda_t - lambda_c)^2 * exposure]\n\n")

cat("6. ROUNDING AND ADDITIVE CORRECTION\n")
cat("   - Round up continuously solved n_k to next integer\n")
cat("   - Add 1 cluster to each arm for conservative coverage\n")
cat("   - Final: n_k_final = ceiling(n_k_continuous) + 1\n\n")

# Now verify with actual numbers
treatment_rate <- 0.005
control_rate <- 0.010
exposure <- 2500
cv <- 0.25
alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.90

z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)
z_beta <- qnorm(target_power)

cat("CALCULATION WITH GIVEN PARAMETERS:\n")
cat("====================================\n\n")

cat("Inputs:\n")
cat("  Treatment rate lambda_t =", treatment_rate, "per child-week\n")
cat("  Control rate lambda_c =", control_rate, "per child-week\n")
cat("  Exposure per cluster E =", exposure, "child-weeks\n")
cat("  Between-cluster CV =", cv, "\n")
cat("  Significance level alpha =", alpha, "(two-sided)\n")
cat("  Target power =", target_power, "\n")
cat("  Allocation ratio = 1:1\n\n")

cat("Critical values:\n")
cat("  z_{alpha/2} = z_{", alpha/2, "} =", z_alpha, "(two-sided)\n")
cat("  z_beta = z_{", target_power, "} =", z_beta, "\n")
cat("  Sum = z_{alpha/2} + z_beta =", z_alpha + z_beta, "\n\n")

inflation <- 1 + cv^2
numerator <- (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * (treatment_rate + control_rate) * inflation
denominator <- (treatment_rate - control_rate)^2 * exposure

n_k_cont <- numerator / denominator
n_k_rounded <- ceiling(n_k_cont)
n_k_final <- n_k_rounded + 1

cat("Sample size calculation:\n")
cat("  Numerator = (", z_alpha + z_beta, ")^2 * (", treatment_rate, "+", control_rate, ") * (1 + 0.25^2)\n")
cat("           =", (z_alpha + z_beta)^2, "*", (treatment_rate + control_rate), "*", inflation, "\n")
cat("           =", numerator, "\n\n")

cat("  Denominator = (", treatment_rate, "-", control_rate, ")^2 * ", exposure, "\n")
cat("             =", (treatment_rate - control_rate)^2, "* ", exposure, "\n")
cat("             =", denominator, "\n\n")

cat("  n_k (continuous) =", numerator, "/", denominator, "\n")
cat("                  =", n_k_cont, "\n\n")

cat("  n_k (rounded up) =", n_k_rounded, "\n")
cat("  n_k (with additive one-cluster correction) =", n_k_final, "\n\n")

# Verification
se_final <- sqrt((treatment_rate + control_rate) * inflation / (n_k_final * exposure))
z_test <- abs(treatment_rate - control_rate) / se_final
power_final <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha - z_test)

se_rounded <- sqrt((treatment_rate + control_rate) * inflation / (n_k_rounded * exposure))
z_test_rounded <- abs(treatment_rate - control_rate) / se_rounded
power_rounded <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha - z_test_rounded)

cat("POWER VERIFICATION:\n")
cat("===================\n\n")

cat("At n_k = ", n_k_final, " clusters per arm (FINAL):\n", sep="")
cat("  SE(lambda_t - lambda_c) =", se_final, "\n")
cat("  Test statistic Z =", z_test, "\n")
cat("  Achieved power (two-sided) =", power_final, "\n")
cat("  Target power =", target_power, "\n")
cat("  Meets target:", ifelse(power_final >= target_power, "YES", "NO"), "\n\n")

cat("At n_k = ", n_k_rounded, " clusters per arm (PRECEDING):\n", sep="")
cat("  Achieved power (two-sided) =", power_rounded, "\n")
cat("  Below target:", ifelse(power_rounded < target_power, "YES", "NO"), "\n\n")

cat("SUMMARY\n")
cat("=======\n")
cat("Clusters per arm: ", n_k_final, "\n", sep="")
cat("Total clusters: ", 2 * n_k_final, "\n", sep="")
cat("Achieved power: ", round(power_final, 4), "\n", sep="")
cat("Method: cluster_rate_cv\n")

# Using alternative derivation and formula structure

# STEP 1: Reproduce the candidate's calculation with explicit formula checking
# ============================================================================

# Input parameters
lambda_t <- 0.005        # treatment rate (per child-week)
lambda_c <- 0.010        # control rate (per child-week)
E <- 2500                # exposure per cluster (child-weeks)
cv <- 0.25               # between-cluster coefficient of variation
alpha <- 0.05            # significance level (two-sided)
beta <- 0.10             # Type II error (1 - target_power = 1 - 0.90)
target_power <- 0.90

# Critical values
z_alpha_2 <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)  # two-sided critical value
z_beta_val <- qnorm(1 - beta)     # power critical value (note: qnorm(power) not qnorm(beta))

cat("===== INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION =====\n\n")
cat("Input Parameters:\n")
cat("  λ_t (treatment rate) =", lambda_t, "per child-week\n")
cat("  λ_c (control rate) =", lambda_c, "per child-week\n")
cat("  E (exposure per cluster) =", E, "child-weeks\n")
cat("  CV (between-cluster) =", cv, "\n")
cat("  α (significance, two-sided) =", alpha, "\n")
cat("  Target power =", target_power, "\n")
cat("  β (Type II error) =", beta, "\n\n")

cat("Critical values:\n")
cat("  z_{α/2} =", z_alpha_2, "\n")
cat("  z_{1-β} (for 90% power) =", z_beta_val, "\n")
cat("  Sum =", z_alpha_2 + z_beta_val, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 2: Check the rate difference formula
# ============================================================================

# Rate difference effect
delta <- lambda_t - lambda_c
cat("Rate difference effect:\n")
cat("  δ = λ_t - λ_c =", delta, "per child-week\n\n")

# Variance inflation factor
inflation_factor <- 1 + cv^2
cat("Variance inflation factor:\n")
cat("  1 + CV² =", inflation_factor, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 3: Apply the cluster-rate CV formula
# ============================================================================

# The formula from Field Trials Chapter 5.6.1 (verified against e2 and e3):
# n_k = [(z_{α/2} + z_β)² × (λ_t + λ_c) × (1 + CV²)] / [(λ_t - λ_c)² × E]

numerator <- (z_alpha_2 + z_beta_val)^2 * (lambda_t + lambda_c) * inflation_factor
denominator <- (delta)^2 * E

n_k_continuous <- numerator / denominator

cat("Sample size formula (cluster-rate CV approximation):\n")
cat("  n_k = [(z_{α/2} + z_β)² × (λ_t + λ_c) × (1 + CV²)] / [(λ_t - λ_c)² × E]\n\n")

cat("Numerator calculation:\n")
cat("  (", z_alpha_2 + z_beta_val, ")² × (", lambda_t, "+", lambda_c, ") × ", 
    inflation_factor, "\n")
cat("  =", (z_alpha_2 + z_beta_val)^2, "×", (lambda_t + lambda_c), "×", 
    inflation_factor, "\n")
cat("  =", numerator, "\n\n")

cat("Denominator calculation:\n")
cat("  (", delta, ")² × ", E, "\n")
cat("  =", delta^2, "×", E, "\n")
cat("  =", denominator, "\n\n")

cat("Continuous solution:\n")
cat("  n_k (continuous) =", numerator, "/", denominator, "\n")
cat("  n_k (continuous) =", n_k_continuous, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: Rounding and additive one-cluster correction
# ============================================================================

n_k_rounded <- ceiling(n_k_continuous)
n_k_final <- n_k_rounded + 1  # additive one-cluster correction

cat("Rounding and correction:\n")
cat("  n_k (continuous) =", n_k_continuous, "\n")
cat("  n_k (rounded up) = ceiling(", n_k_continuous, ") =", n_k_rounded, "\n")
cat("  n_k (final, with additive correction) =", n_k_rounded, "+ 1 =", n_k_final, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: Verify achieved power at both designs
# ============================================================================

# For two-sided test at n_k clusters per arm:
# SE(λ̂_t - λ̂_c) = sqrt{[λ_t + λ_c] × (1 + CV²) / (n_k × E)}
# Z-statistic = |δ| / SE
# Power = 1 - Φ(z_{α/2} - |Z|)  [approximately, for large Z]

# At final design (n_k = n_k_final)
se_final <- sqrt((lambda_t + lambda_c) * inflation_factor / (n_k_final * E))
z_stat_final <- abs(delta) / se_final
power_final <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha_2 - z_stat_final)

cat("Power verification at n_k =", n_k_final, "(FINAL):\n")
cat("  SE(λ̂_t - λ̂_c) = sqrt{[", lambda_t, "+", lambda_c, "] × ", 
    inflation_factor, "/ (", n_k_final, "×", E, ")}\n")
cat("  SE =", se_final, "\n")
cat("  Z-statistic = |", delta, "| /", se_final, "=", z_stat_final, "\n")
cat("  Power (two-sided) = 1 - Φ(", z_alpha_2, "-", z_stat_final, ")\n")
cat("           = 1 - Φ(", z_alpha_2 - z_stat_final, ")\n")
cat("           =", power_final, "\n")
cat("  Target power =", target_power, "\n")
cat("  Check: Power ≥ target?", power_final >= target_power, "\n\n")

# At preceding design (n_k = n_k_rounded)
se_rounded <- sqrt((lambda_t + lambda_c) * inflation_factor / (n_k_rounded * E))
z_stat_rounded <- abs(delta) / se_rounded
power_rounded <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha_2 - z_stat_rounded)

cat("Power verification at n_k =", n_k_rounded, "(PRECEDING):\n")
cat("  SE(λ̂_t - λ̂_c) =", se_rounded, "\n")
cat("  Z-statistic =", z_stat_rounded, "\n")
cat("  Power (two-sided) =", power_rounded, "\n")
cat("  Check: Power < target?", power_rounded < target_power, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 6: Compare to candidate answer
# ============================================================================

cat("=====   COMPARISON TO CANDIDATE ANSWER   =====\n\n")

cat("Candidate reported:\n")
cat("  Sample size: 4 clusters per arm\n")
cat("  Achieved power at n=4: 0.977284\n")
cat("  Power at n=3: 0.92922\n\n")

cat("Independent verification:\n")
cat("  Sample size: ", n_k_final, " clusters per arm\n", sep="")
cat("  Achieved power at n=", n_k_final, ": ", round(power_final, 6), "\n", sep="")
cat("  Power at n=", n_k_rounded, ": ", round(power_rounded, 6), "\n", sep="")

cat("\nNumerical agreement:\n")
cat("  Sample size match:", n_k_final == 4, "\n")
cat("  Final power match:", abs(power_final - 0.977284) < 0.000001, "\n")
cat("  Preceding power match:", abs(power_rounded - 0.92922) < 0.000001, "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 7: Check formula correctness against methodology
# ============================================================================

cat("\n===== FORMULA VALIDATION =====\n\n")

cat("Field Trials Chapter 5.6.1 Cluster-Rate CV Approximation:\n")
cat("- Accounts for Poisson variation plus between-cluster overdispersion\n")
cat("- Variance inflation factor: 1 + CV²\n")
cat("- For rate λ in cluster with exposure E:\n")
cat("    Var(λ̂) = λ × (1 + CV²) / E\n")
cat("- Two-arm difference variance:\n")
cat("    Var(λ̂_t - λ̂_c) = (λ_t + λ_c) × (1 + CV²) / E\n")
cat("- Standard two-sample z-test formula applies at cluster level\n\n")

cat("Verification of inflation factor:\n")
cat("  CV² =", cv^2, "\n")
cat("  1 + CV² =", inflation_factor, "✓\n\n")

cat("Verification of effect size:\n")
cat("  Expected events per cluster:\n")
cat("    Treatment: λ_t × E =", lambda_t * E, "\n")
cat("    Control: λ_c × E =", lambda_c * E, "\n")
cat("  Difference: λ_t × E - λ_c × E =", (lambda_t - lambda_c) * E, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# Final structured output
# ============================================================================

library(jsonlite)

final_result <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = n_k_final, unit = "clusters_per_arm"),
    list(metric = "achieved_power", value = round(power_final, 6), unit = "proportion"),
    list(metric = "power_at_preceding_design", value = round(power_rounded, 6), unit = "proportion"),
    list(metric = "continuous_solution", value = round(n_k_continuous, 6), unit = "clusters_per_arm")
  )
)

cat("POWER_AGENT_RESULT=", jsonlite::toJSON(final_result, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15), "\n", sep="")

cat("===== METHODOLOGICAL CRITIQUE =====\n\n")

# Input parameters
lambda_t <- 0.005
lambda_c <- 0.010
E <- 2500
cv <- 0.25
alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.90

# ============================================================================
# ASSUMPTION 1: Event count adequacy for large-sample approximation
# ============================================================================

cat("ASSUMPTION 1: Event Count and Large-Sample Approximation Validity\n")
cat("===============================================================\n\n")

events_per_cluster_t <- lambda_t * E
events_per_cluster_c <- lambda_c * E

cat("Expected events per cluster:\n")
cat("  Treatment cluster: λ_t × E =", lambda_t, "×", E, "=", events_per_cluster_t, "\n")
cat("  Control cluster: λ_c × E =", lambda_c, "×", E, "=", events_per_cluster_c, "\n")

cat("\nGuidance for Poisson-based approximations:\n")
cat("  - n ≥ 5 events per group: basic validity\n")
cat("  - n ≥ 10–25 events per group: good approximation\n")
cat("  - n ≥ 100+ events per group: excellent approximation\n")

if (events_per_cluster_t >= 10 && events_per_cluster_c >= 10) {
  cat("\n✓ Event counts (12.5 and 25) are in the borderline range [10, 25].\n")
  cat("  Normal approximation to Poisson is reasonable but not ideal.\n")
} else {
  cat("\n⚠ Event counts are low; normal approximation may be questionable.\n")
}

cat("\nImplications:\n")
cat("  - The sample size formula uses z-test (normal approximation)\n")
cat("  - With ~12.5 events in treatment and 25 in control, the normal\n")
cat("    approximation is acceptable but may introduce some error\n")
cat("  - Actual power via exact Poisson test might differ slightly\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# ASSUMPTION 2: Between-cluster CV specification and accuracy
# ============================================================================

cat("\nASSUMPTION 2: Between-Cluster Coefficient of Variation\n")
cat("========================================================\n\n")

cat("The formula assumes CV² =", cv^2, "captures all between-cluster variation.\n")
cat("Variance inflation factor: 1 + CV² =", 1 + cv^2, "\n\n")

cat("Interpretation of CV = 0.25:\n")
cat("  - This is a moderate amount of between-cluster heterogeneity\n")
cat("  - Implies cluster-level rates vary with SD = 0.25 × mean rate\n")
cat("  - For control rate λ_c = 0.010: cluster rates vary ~SD ≈ 0.0025\n")
cat("    (i.e., some clusters ~0.008, others ~0.012)\n")

cat("\nAssumptions embedded:\n")
cat("  1. CV applies equally to both treatment and control arms\n")
cat("  2. Between-cluster variation follows the (1 + CV²) model\n")
cat("  3. CV is constant across different exposure levels\n")
cat("  4. No interaction between treatment effect and cluster-level variation\n\n")

cat("If actual CV differs from 0.25, sample size requirements will change:\n")
cat("  - CV = 0.15: inflation factor = 1.0225 (smaller sample needed)\n")
cat("  - CV = 0.25: inflation factor = 1.0625 (as specified)\n")
cat("  - CV = 0.40: inflation factor = 1.16 (larger sample needed)\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# ASSUMPTION 3: Equal exposure across clusters
# ============================================================================

cat("ASSUMPTION 3: Equal Exposure Across Clusters\n")
cat("==============================================\n\n")

cat("Assumption: Each cluster has exactly E =", E, "child-weeks\n")
cat("This is a strong assumption requiring:\n")
cat("  1. Consistent follow-up time per child\n")
cat("  2. No differential dropout or loss-to-follow-up\n")
cat("  3. No variation in number of children per cluster\n\n")

cat("If actual exposure varies (e.g., ±10% variation):\n")
cat("  - Some clusters will have fewer events than expected\n")
cat("  - Effective information content will be reduced\n")
cat("  - Sample size may be insufficient in practice\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# ASSUMPTION 4: Formula derivation and null hypothesis
# ============================================================================

cat("ASSUMPTION 4: Rate Difference as Estimand\n")
cat("==========================================\n\n")

cat("The formula tests the null hypothesis:\n")
cat("  H₀: λ_t = λ_c\n")
cat("  H₁: λ_t ≠ λ_c (two-sided)\n\n")

cat("Effect size (rate difference):\n")
cat("  δ = λ_t - λ_c =", lambda_t - lambda_c, "per child-week\n")
cat("  Relative reduction: (λ_c - λ_t) / λ_c =", 
    (lambda_c - lambda_t) / lambda_c * 100, "%\n\n")

cat("This is a 50% reduction in event rate.\n")
cat("The sample size formula is sensitive to the effect size;\n")
cat("if actual effect differs from this assumption, power will change.\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# ASSUMPTION 5: Additive one-cluster correction
# ============================================================================

cat("ASSUMPTION 5: Additive One-Cluster Correction\n")
cat("==============================================\n\n")

cat("Continuous solution: n_k = 2.679 clusters per arm\n")
cat("Rounded up: n_k = 3 clusters per arm\n")
cat("With additive correction: n_k = 4 clusters per arm\n\n")

cat("The one-cluster correction is:\n")
cat("  1. Conservative (adds 'insurance' for rounding)\n")
cat("  2. Simple to implement\n")
cat("  3. Assumes equal information gain from each cluster\n")
cat("  4. May overestimate for very small initial sample sizes\n\n")

cat("In this case:\n")
cat("  - Original rounded sample (n=3) achieves 92.92% power\n")
cat("  - Which already exceeds the target of 90%\n")
cat("  - Adding one cluster increases power to 97.73%\n")
cat("  - This provides substantial margin above target\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# ASSUMPTION 6: Independence and Clustering Structure
# ============================================================================

cat("ASSUMPTION 6: Cluster Structure and Independence\n")
cat("=================================================\n\n")

cat("Assumed structure:\n")
cat("  - n_k = 4 independent clusters per arm (8 total)\n")
cat("  - Clusters are the unit of randomization\n")
cat("  - Children within a cluster are NOT independent\n")
cat("    (this is implicitly handled via the CV inflation factor)\n\n")

cat("Important considerations:\n")
cat("  - The formula assumes the between-cluster CV properly accounts\n")
cat("    for within-cluster correlation\n")
cat("  - If children are highly correlated within clusters,\n")
cat("    the actual power may be lower than calculated\n")
cat("  - The (1 + CV²) factor is an approximation that works well\n")
cat("    when CV is not too large\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# ASSUMPTION 7: Two-sided testing
# ============================================================================

cat("ASSUMPTION 7: Two-Sided vs. One-Sided Testing\n")
cat("==============================================\n\n")

cat("As specified: Two-sided test at α = 0.05\n")
cat("Critical value: z_{α/2} = z_{0.025} = 1.9600\n\n")

cat("This means:\n")
cat("  - Significance allocated 0.025 to each tail\n")
cat("  - Tests detect either λ_t < λ_c or λ_t > λ_c\n")
cat("  - With equal allocation (1:1), power is symmetric\n")
cat("  - Cannot use the 'advantage' of one-sided testing\n\n")

cat("The calculation is correct for two-sided hypothesis.\n\n")

# OVERALL ASSESSMENT
# ============================================================================

cat("=====  OVERALL ASSESSMENT OF ASSUMPTIONS  =====\n\n")

cat("CRITICAL ASSUMPTIONS (must hold for validity):\n")
cat("  ✓ Cluster-randomized design with independent clusters\n")
cat("  ✓ Two-sided test at α = 0.05 (specified)\n")
cat("  ⚠ Event counts (12.5–25) adequate for normal approximation\n")
cat("    (acceptable but borderline)\n")
cat("  ⚠ Between-cluster CV = 0.25 accurately represents variation\n")
cat("    (requires sensitivity analysis if uncertain)\n\n")

cat("  2. Assumes fixed exposure (2500 child-weeks per cluster)\n")
cat("  3. Does not account for covariates, stratification, or matching\n")
cat("  4. CV specification is assumed known; if misspecified,\n")
cat("     actual power may differ substantially\n")
cat("  5. Formula is an approximation; exact power from simulation\n")
cat("     might show minor differences\n\n")

cat("  - Power at n=4 is 97.73%, well above 90% target\n")
cat("  - This provides margin for minor deviations in assumptions\n")
cat("  - If CV is overestimated (lower actual variation),\n")
cat("    actual power will be higher (favorable)\n")
cat("  - If CV is underestimated (higher actual variation),\n")
cat("    actual power will be lower (unfavorable)\n\n")

# Final cross-check: verify power calculations using alternative formulation
# and ensure consistency of the test statistic

cat("===== POWER CALCULATION CROSS-CHECK =====\n\n")

# Parameters
lambda_t <- 0.005
lambda_c <- 0.010
E <- 2500
cv <- 0.25
alpha <- 0.05
n_final <- 4
n_preceding <- 3

z_alpha_2 <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)

cat("Parameters:\n")
cat("  λ_t =", lambda_t, ", λ_c =", lambda_c, "\n")
cat("  E =", E, ", CV =", cv, "\n")
cat("  α =", alpha, "(two-sided), z_{α/2} =", z_alpha_2, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# Method 1: Using rate difference directly
# ============================================================================

cat("METHOD 1: Rate Difference Test\n")
cat("================================\n\n")

delta <- lambda_t - lambda_c
inflation <- 1 + cv^2

# Standard error of rate difference at H1 with n clusters per arm
se_rate_1 <- sqrt((lambda_t + lambda_c) * inflation / (n_final * E))

# Test statistic (absolute value of effect divided by SE)
z_stat_1 <- abs(delta) / se_rate_1

# Power for two-sided test: P(|Z| > z_α/2 | H1)
# = 1 - P(|Z| ≤ z_α/2 | H1)
# = 1 - [Φ(z_α/2 - z_stat) - Φ(-z_α/2 - z_stat)]
# ≈ 1 - Φ(z_α/2 - z_stat) for large z_stat
# = Φ(z_stat - z_α/2)

power_1_final <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha_2 - z_stat_1)

cat("At n =", n_final, "clusters per arm:\n")
cat("  SE(λ̂_t - λ̂_c) = sqrt{(", lambda_t, "+", lambda_c, ") × ", 
    inflation, "/ (", n_final, "×", E, ")}\n")
cat("                =", se_rate_1, "\n")
cat("  Z-statistic = |", delta, "| /", se_rate_1, "=", z_stat_1, "\n")
cat("  Power = 1 - Φ(", z_alpha_2, "-", z_stat_1, ")\n")
cat("        = 1 - Φ(", z_alpha_2 - z_stat_1, ")\n")
cat("        =", power_1_final, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# Method 2: Using event difference (alternative formulation)
# ============================================================================

cat("METHOD 2: Event Count Difference Test\n")
cat("======================================\n\n")

m_t <- lambda_t * E  # expected events in treatment cluster
m_c <- lambda_c * E  # expected events in control cluster
delta_m <- m_t - m_c # event difference per cluster

# Variance of event difference with between-cluster inflation
# Var(m_t) = m_t * (1 + CV²)
# Var(m_c) = m_c * (1 + CV²)
# For n clusters, averaging gives variance:
var_delta_m <- (m_t + m_c) * inflation / n_final

se_event_diff <- sqrt(var_delta_m)

# Test statistic
z_stat_2 <- abs(delta_m) / se_event_diff

# Power
power_2_final <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha_2 - z_stat_2)

cat("At n =", n_final, "clusters per arm:\n")
cat("  Expected events: λ_t × E =", m_t, ", λ_c × E =", m_c, "\n")
cat("  Event difference: δ_m =", delta_m, "\n")
cat("  SE(m̂_t - m̂_c) = sqrt{(", m_t, "+", m_c, ") × ", 
    inflation, "/ ", n_final, "}\n")
cat("                =", se_event_diff, "\n")
cat("  Z-statistic =", z_stat_2, "\n")
cat("  Power =", power_2_final, "\n\n")

# Note: These should give the same test statistic
cat("Consistency check:\n")
cat("  Method 1 Z-statistic:", z_stat_1, "\n")
cat("  Method 2 Z-statistic:", z_stat_2, "\n")
cat("  Difference:", abs(z_stat_1 - z_stat_2), "\n")
cat("  Match:", abs(z_stat_1 - z_stat_2) < 1e-10, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# Preceding design (n = 3)
# ============================================================================

cat("PRECEDING DESIGN: n =", n_preceding, "clusters per arm\n")
cat("=====================================================\n\n")

se_rate_prec <- sqrt((lambda_t + lambda_c) * inflation / (n_preceding * E))
z_stat_prec <- abs(delta) / se_rate_prec
power_prec <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha_2 - z_stat_prec)

cat("  SE(λ̂_t - λ̂_c) =", se_rate_prec, "\n")
cat("  Z-statistic =", z_stat_prec, "\n")
cat("  Power =", power_prec, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# Summary table
# ============================================================================

cat("SUMMARY TABLE\n")
cat("==============\n\n")

results_df <- data.frame(
  Design = c(paste("n = ", n_preceding, " (preceding)", sep=""),
             paste("n = ", n_final, " (final)", sep="")),
  SE = c(se_rate_prec, se_rate_1),
  Z_stat = c(z_stat_prec, z_stat_1),
  Power = c(power_prec, power_1_final),
  Meets_90pct = c(
    ifelse(power_prec >= 0.90, "YES", "NO"),
    ifelse(power_1_final >= 0.90, "YES", "NO")
  )
)

print(results_df)

cat("\n\nRounding and correction logic:\n")
cat("  Continuous n_k = 2.679 clusters per arm\n")
cat("  ↓ ceiling(2.679) = 3\n")
cat("  ↓ +1 for additive correction = 4\n\n")

cat("Design selection:\n")
cat("  n = 3 clusters per arm achieves", round(power_prec, 4), "power\n")

# Cluster-rate coefficient-of-variation approximation
# Field Trials of Health Interventions, Chapter 5, Section 6.1
# With additive one-cluster correction

# Input parameters
treatment_rate <- 0.005        # per child-week
control_rate <- 0.010          # per child-week
exposure_per_cluster <- 2500   # child-weeks per cluster
cv <- 0.25                     # between-cluster coefficient of variation
alpha <- 0.05                  # significance level, two-sided
target_power <- 0.90           # target power
allocation_ratio <- 1          # equal allocation (1:1)

# Two-sided test critical value
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)

# Power critical value
z_power <- qnorm(target_power)

# Rate difference (H0: lambda_t = lambda_c)
lambda_t <- treatment_rate
lambda_c <- control_rate
delta <- lambda_t - lambda_c

cat("Input Parameters:\n")
cat("Treatment rate (λ_t):", lambda_t, "per child-week\n")
cat("Control rate (λ_c):", lambda_c, "per child-week\n")
cat("Rate difference (δ):", delta, "per child-week\n")
cat("Between-cluster CV:", cv, "\n")
cat("Exposure per cluster:", exposure_per_cluster, "child-weeks\n")
cat("Significance level (two-sided):", alpha, "\n")
cat("Target power:", target_power, "\n")
cat("z_α/2:", z_alpha, "\n")
cat("z_power:", z_power, "\n\n")

# Under H0, both arms have rate λ_c (null hypothesis of no difference)
# Expected number of events per cluster under H0
m0 <- exposure_per_cluster * lambda_c

# Under H1, treatment arm has rate λ_t, control arm has rate λ_c
m_t <- exposure_per_cluster * lambda_t  # expected events in treatment arm
m_c <- exposure_per_cluster * lambda_c  # expected events in control arm

cat("Expected events per cluster under H0 (both arms):", m0, "\n")
cat("Expected events in treatment cluster:", m_t, "\n")
cat("Expected events in control cluster:", m_c, "\n\n")

# Variance inflation factor due to between-cluster variation
# var = E[m] * (1 + CV²) where var is cluster-level variance
inflation_factor <- 1 + cv^2

cat("Variance inflation factor (1 + CV²):", inflation_factor, "\n\n")

# Cluster-level variance under H0 (null)
# For Poisson with overdispersion: var = m * (1 + CV²)
var_null <- m0 * inflation_factor

# Cluster-level variance under H1 (alternative)
# var_t = m_t * (1 + CV²)
# var_c = m_c * (1 + CV²)
var_treatment <- m_t * inflation_factor
var_control <- m_c * inflation_factor

# For two-sided test, pooled variance (assuming equal allocation)
var_pooled_h1 <- (var_treatment + var_control) / 2

cat("Variance under H0 (both arms):", var_null, "\n")
cat("Variance in treatment arm under H1:", var_treatment, "\n")
cat("Variance in control arm under H1:", var_control, "\n")
cat("Pooled variance under H1:", var_pooled_h1, "\n\n")

# Expected rate difference: δ = λ_t - λ_c
expected_delta <- lambda_t - lambda_c

# For cluster-level analysis, the expected difference per cluster is:
expected_cluster_difference <- exposure_per_cluster * expected_delta

cat("Expected cluster-level rate difference:", expected_delta, "per child-week\n")
cat("Expected event difference per cluster:", expected_cluster_difference, "\n\n")

# Number of clusters per arm (before rounding and correction)
# Using two-sample z-test for difference of means formula:
# n = (z_α/2 + z_β)² * (var_null / (treatment_effect)²)
# 
# However, for cluster-level analysis with overdispersion:
# The variance structure is more complex. The standard formula for 
# cluster-randomized trials is:
#
# n_k = [(z_α/2 + z_β)² * σ²] / effect²
#
# where effect is cluster-level rate difference
# σ² is the pooled variance

# Under the CV approximation, we use:
# var of difference = var_treatment + var_control (for independent clusters)
# For each arm: variance of (λ̂_t - λ̂_c) needs the sum of variances
# 
# Standard two-sample cluster-level formula:
# n_k = [(z_α/2 + z_β)² * (var_t + var_c)] / (effect²)
#
# where effect = m_t - m_c (cluster-level difference)

effect_cluster <- m_t - m_c  # difference in expected events per cluster
effect_cluster_rate <- expected_delta  # difference in rates

cat("Effect (cluster event difference):", effect_cluster, "\n")
cat("Effect (rate difference):", effect_cluster_rate, "per child-week\n\n")

# Sample size calculation
# For testing difference in Poisson rates with cluster structure:
# n_k = (z_α/2 + z_β)² * (var_null * 2) / (effect²)
# 
# With variance inflation and equal allocation:
n_k_formula <- (z_alpha + z_power)^2 * (var_treatment + var_control) / (effect_cluster^2)

cat("Sample size formula calculation:\n")
cat("  Numerator: (z_α/2 + z_β)² * (var_t + var_c)\n")
cat("           = (", z_alpha, "+", z_power, ")² * (", var_treatment, "+", var_control, ")\n")
cat("           = ", (z_alpha + z_power)^2, "* ", (var_treatment + var_control), "\n")
cat("           = ", (z_alpha + z_power)^2 * (var_treatment + var_control), "\n")
cat("  Denominator: effect² = ", effect_cluster, "² =", effect_cluster^2, "\n")
cat("  n_k (continuous) = ", n_k_formula, "\n\n")

# Additive one-cluster correction
# Add 1 cluster to each arm for conservative coverage
n_k_continuous <- n_k_formula
n_k_rounded <- ceiling(n_k_continuous)
n_k_with_correction <- n_k_rounded + 1

cat("Rounding and correction:\n")
cat("  n_k continuous =", n_k_continuous, "\n")
cat("  n_k rounded up =", n_k_rounded, "\n")
cat("  n_k with one-cluster correction = ", n_k_rounded, "+ 1 =", n_k_with_correction, "\n\n")

# Verification: calculate achieved power at final sample size
# Power = P(Z > z_crit | H1), where Z is test statistic under H1

# Test statistic: Z = (λ̂_t - λ̂_c) / SE(λ̂_t - λ̂_c)
# Under H1 (with n_k clusters per arm):
# E[λ̂_t] = λ_t, E[λ̂_c] = λ_c
# Var[λ̂_t] = var_treatment / n_k
# Var[λ̂_c] = var_control / n_k
# SE² = var_treatment/n_k + var_control/n_k

se_squared_h1 <- (var_treatment + var_control) / n_k_with_correction
se_h1 <- sqrt(se_squared_h1)

# Non-centrality parameter
ncp <- (m_t - m_c) / se_h1

# Achieved power
achieved_power <- pnorm(ncp - z_alpha) + pnorm(-ncp - z_alpha)
# For one-sided upper tail (or two-sided):
achieved_power_twosided <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha - ncp) + pnorm(-z_alpha - ncp)
achieved_power_twosided_correct <- pnorm(ncp - z_alpha) + pnorm(-ncp - z_alpha)

# More directly for two-sided:
# P(|Z| > z_α/2) under H1 = 1 - Φ(z_α/2 - ncp) + Φ(-z_α/2 - ncp)
# = Φ(ncp - z_α/2) + Φ(-z_α/2 - ncp)
# ≈ Φ(ncp - z_α/2) for large ncp

achieved_power <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha - ncp)

cat("Verification at n_k =", n_k_with_correction, "clusters per arm:\n")
cat("  SE under H1:", se_h1, "\n")
cat("  Effect size (cluster events):", m_t - m_c, "\n")
cat("  Non-centrality parameter:", ncp, "\n")
cat("  Achieved power (two-sided):", achieved_power, "\n")
cat("  Target power:", target_power, "\n\n")

# Also verify at the rounded but uncorrected sample size
se_squared_h1_rounded <- (var_treatment + var_control) / n_k_rounded
se_h1_rounded <- sqrt(se_squared_h1_rounded)
ncp_rounded <- (m_t - m_c) / se_h1_rounded
achieved_power_rounded <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha - ncp_rounded)

cat("Verification at n_k =", n_k_rounded, "clusters per arm (before correction):\n")
cat("  Achieved power (two-sided):", achieved_power_rounded, "\n\n")

# Final result
cat("=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "\n")
cat("FINAL RESULT\n")
cat("=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "\n")
cat("Sample size (clusters per arm):", n_k_with_correction, "\n")
cat("Method: cluster_rate_cv with additive one-cluster correction\n")
cat("Achieved power at n_k =", n_k_with_correction, ":", achieved_power, "\n")
cat("Power at n_k =", n_k_rounded, ":", achieved_power_rounded, "\n")

# JSON result for structured reporting
results <- list(
  sample_size = n_k_with_correction,
  sample_size_unit = "clusters_per_arm",
  method = "cluster_rate_cv",
  achieved_power = achieved_power,
  power_at_preceding_design = achieved_power_rounded,
  preceding_design_sample_size = n_k_rounded
)

cat("\nStructured result:\n")
print(jsonlite::toJSON(results, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))

# Output for POWER_AGENT_RESULT
library(jsonlite)
output <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = n_k_with_correction, unit = "clusters_per_arm"),
    list(metric = "achieved_power", value = round(achieved_power, 6), unit = "proportion"),
    list(metric = "power_at_preceding_design", value = round(achieved_power_rounded, 6), unit = "proportion")
  )
)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=" %+% jsonlite::toJSON(output, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))

# Detailed documentation and verification of the cluster-rate CV approximation
# Field Trials of Health Interventions, Chapter 5, Section 6.1

cat("CLUSTER-RATE COEFFICIENT-OF-VARIATION APPROXIMATION\n")
cat("From: Field Trials of Health Interventions, Chapter 5, Section 6.1\n")
cat("With: Additive one-cluster correction\n\n")

cat("METHODOLOGY:\n")
cat("=============\n\n")

cat("1. RATE OUTCOMES IN CLUSTERS\n")
cat("   - Each cluster has exposure E (in child-weeks)\n")
cat("   - Event rate lambda is observed with overdispersion relative to Poisson\n")
cat("   - Between-cluster variation captured via coefficient of variation CV\n\n")

cat("2. VARIANCE STRUCTURE FOR RATE ESTIMATION\n")
cat("   For a single cluster, the variance of the rate estimator is:\n")
cat("   Var(lambda_hat) = lambda * (1 + CV^2) / exposure\n")
cat("   where (1 + CV^2) accounts for extra-Poisson variation\n\n")

cat("3. TWO-ARM RATE DIFFERENCE\n")
cat("   For treatment vs. control (independent cluster samples):\n")
cat("   Var(lambda_t_hat - lambda_c_hat) [single cluster each]\n")
cat("   = [lambda_t + lambda_c] * (1 + CV^2) / exposure\n\n")

cat("4. CLUSTER-AVERAGED RATE DIFFERENCE\n")
cat("   With n_k clusters per arm, averaging cluster estimates:\n")
cat("   SE(lambda_t_bar - lambda_c_bar) = sqrt{[lambda_t + lambda_c] * (1 + CV^2) / (n_k * exposure)}\n\n")

cat("5. SAMPLE SIZE FORMULA (from standard two-sample rate difference)\n")
cat("   n_k = [(z_{alpha/2} + z_beta)^2 * (lambda_t + lambda_c) * (1 + CV^2)] / \n")
cat("         [(lambda_t - lambda_c)^2 * exposure]\n\n")

cat("6. ROUNDING AND ADDITIVE CORRECTION\n")
cat("   - Round up continuously solved n_k to next integer\n")
cat("   - Add 1 cluster to each arm for conservative coverage\n")
cat("   - Final: n_k_final = ceiling(n_k_continuous) + 1\n\n")

# Now verify with actual numbers
treatment_rate <- 0.005
control_rate <- 0.010
exposure <- 2500
cv <- 0.25
alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.90

z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)
z_beta <- qnorm(target_power)

cat("CALCULATION WITH GIVEN PARAMETERS:\n")
cat("====================================\n\n")

cat("Inputs:\n")
cat("  Treatment rate lambda_t =", treatment_rate, "per child-week\n")
cat("  Control rate lambda_c =", control_rate, "per child-week\n")
cat("  Exposure per cluster E =", exposure, "child-weeks\n")
cat("  Between-cluster CV =", cv, "\n")
cat("  Significance level alpha =", alpha, "(two-sided)\n")
cat("  Target power =", target_power, "\n")
cat("  Allocation ratio = 1:1\n\n")

cat("Critical values:\n")
cat("  z_{alpha/2} = z_{", alpha/2, "} =", z_alpha, "(two-sided)\n")
cat("  z_beta = z_{", target_power, "} =", z_beta, "\n")
cat("  Sum = z_{alpha/2} + z_beta =", z_alpha + z_beta, "\n\n")

inflation <- 1 + cv^2
numerator <- (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * (treatment_rate + control_rate) * inflation
denominator <- (treatment_rate - control_rate)^2 * exposure

n_k_cont <- numerator / denominator
n_k_rounded <- ceiling(n_k_cont)
n_k_final <- n_k_rounded + 1

cat("Sample size calculation:\n")
cat("  Numerator = (", z_alpha + z_beta, ")^2 * (", treatment_rate, "+", control_rate, ") * (1 + 0.25^2)\n")
cat("           =", (z_alpha + z_beta)^2, "*", (treatment_rate + control_rate), "*", inflation, "\n")
cat("           =", numerator, "\n\n")

cat("  Denominator = (", treatment_rate, "-", control_rate, ")^2 * ", exposure, "\n")
cat("             =", (treatment_rate - control_rate)^2, "* ", exposure, "\n")
cat("             =", denominator, "\n\n")

cat("  n_k (continuous) =", numerator, "/", denominator, "\n")
cat("                  =", n_k_cont, "\n\n")

cat("  n_k (rounded up) =", n_k_rounded, "\n")
cat("  n_k (with additive one-cluster correction) =", n_k_final, "\n\n")

# Verification
se_final <- sqrt((treatment_rate + control_rate) * inflation / (n_k_final * exposure))
z_test <- abs(treatment_rate - control_rate) / se_final
power_final <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha - z_test)

se_rounded <- sqrt((treatment_rate + control_rate) * inflation / (n_k_rounded * exposure))
z_test_rounded <- abs(treatment_rate - control_rate) / se_rounded
power_rounded <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha - z_test_rounded)

cat("POWER VERIFICATION:\n")
cat("===================\n\n")

cat("At n_k = ", n_k_final, " clusters per arm (FINAL):\n", sep="")
cat("  SE(lambda_t - lambda_c) =", se_final, "\n")
cat("  Test statistic Z =", z_test, "\n")
cat("  Achieved power (two-sided) =", power_final, "\n")
cat("  Target power =", target_power, "\n")
cat("  Meets target:", ifelse(power_final >= target_power, "YES", "NO"), "\n\n")

cat("At n_k = ", n_k_rounded, " clusters per arm (PRECEDING):\n", sep="")
cat("  Achieved power (two-sided) =", power_rounded, "\n")
cat("  Below target:", ifelse(power_rounded < target_power, "YES", "NO"), "\n\n")

cat("SUMMARY\n")
cat("=======\n")
cat("Clusters per arm: ", n_k_final, "\n", sep="")
cat("Total clusters: ", 2 * n_k_final, "\n", sep="")
cat("Achieved power: ", round(power_final, 4), "\n", sep="")
cat("Method: cluster_rate_cv\n")

# Using alternative derivation and formula structure

# STEP 1: Reproduce the candidate's calculation with explicit formula checking
# ============================================================================

# Input parameters
lambda_t <- 0.005        # treatment rate (per child-week)
lambda_c <- 0.010        # control rate (per child-week)
E <- 2500                # exposure per cluster (child-weeks)
cv <- 0.25               # between-cluster coefficient of variation
alpha <- 0.05            # significance level (two-sided)
beta <- 0.10             # Type II error (1 - target_power = 1 - 0.90)
target_power <- 0.90

# Critical values
z_alpha_2 <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)  # two-sided critical value
z_beta_val <- qnorm(1 - beta)     # power critical value (note: qnorm(power) not qnorm(beta))

cat("===== INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION =====\n\n")
cat("Input Parameters:\n")
cat("  λ_t (treatment rate) =", lambda_t, "per child-week\n")
cat("  λ_c (control rate) =", lambda_c, "per child-week\n")
cat("  E (exposure per cluster) =", E, "child-weeks\n")
cat("  CV (between-cluster) =", cv, "\n")
cat("  α (significance, two-sided) =", alpha, "\n")
cat("  Target power =", target_power, "\n")
cat("  β (Type II error) =", beta, "\n\n")

cat("Critical values:\n")
cat("  z_{α/2} =", z_alpha_2, "\n")
cat("  z_{1-β} (for 90% power) =", z_beta_val, "\n")
cat("  Sum =", z_alpha_2 + z_beta_val, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 2: Check the rate difference formula
# ============================================================================

# Rate difference effect
delta <- lambda_t - lambda_c
cat("Rate difference effect:\n")
cat("  δ = λ_t - λ_c =", delta, "per child-week\n\n")

# Variance inflation factor
inflation_factor <- 1 + cv^2
cat("Variance inflation factor:\n")
cat("  1 + CV² =", inflation_factor, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 3: Apply the cluster-rate CV formula
# ============================================================================

# The formula from Field Trials Chapter 5.6.1 (verified against e2 and e3):
# n_k = [(z_{α/2} + z_β)² × (λ_t + λ_c) × (1 + CV²)] / [(λ_t - λ_c)² × E]

numerator <- (z_alpha_2 + z_beta_val)^2 * (lambda_t + lambda_c) * inflation_factor
denominator <- (delta)^2 * E

n_k_continuous <- numerator / denominator

cat("Sample size formula (cluster-rate CV approximation):\n")
cat("  n_k = [(z_{α/2} + z_β)² × (λ_t + λ_c) × (1 + CV²)] / [(λ_t - λ_c)² × E]\n\n")

cat("Numerator calculation:\n")
cat("  (", z_alpha_2 + z_beta_val, ")² × (", lambda_t, "+", lambda_c, ") × ", 
    inflation_factor, "\n")
cat("  =", (z_alpha_2 + z_beta_val)^2, "×", (lambda_t + lambda_c), "×", 
    inflation_factor, "\n")
cat("  =", numerator, "\n\n")

cat("Denominator calculation:\n")
cat("  (", delta, ")² × ", E, "\n")
cat("  =", delta^2, "×", E, "\n")
cat("  =", denominator, "\n\n")

cat("Continuous solution:\n")
cat("  n_k (continuous) =", numerator, "/", denominator, "\n")
cat("  n_k (continuous) =", n_k_continuous, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: Rounding and additive one-cluster correction
# ============================================================================

n_k_rounded <- ceiling(n_k_continuous)
n_k_final <- n_k_rounded + 1  # additive one-cluster correction

cat("Rounding and correction:\n")
cat("  n_k (continuous) =", n_k_continuous, "\n")
cat("  n_k (rounded up) = ceiling(", n_k_continuous, ") =", n_k_rounded, "\n")
cat("  n_k (final, with additive correction) =", n_k_rounded, "+ 1 =", n_k_final, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: Verify achieved power at both designs
# ============================================================================

# For two-sided test at n_k clusters per arm:
# SE(λ̂_t - λ̂_c) = sqrt{[λ_t + λ_c] × (1 + CV²) / (n_k × E)}
# Z-statistic = |δ| / SE
# Power = 1 - Φ(z_{α/2} - |Z|)  [approximately, for large Z]

# At final design (n_k = n_k_final)
se_final <- sqrt((lambda_t + lambda_c) * inflation_factor / (n_k_final * E))
z_stat_final <- abs(delta) / se_final
power_final <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha_2 - z_stat_final)

cat("Power verification at n_k =", n_k_final, "(FINAL):\n")
cat("  SE(λ̂_t - λ̂_c) = sqrt{[", lambda_t, "+", lambda_c, "] × ", 
    inflation_factor, "/ (", n_k_final, "×", E, ")}\n")
cat("  SE =", se_final, "\n")
cat("  Z-statistic = |", delta, "| /", se_final, "=", z_stat_final, "\n")
cat("  Power (two-sided) = 1 - Φ(", z_alpha_2, "-", z_stat_final, ")\n")
cat("           = 1 - Φ(", z_alpha_2 - z_stat_final, ")\n")
cat("           =", power_final, "\n")
cat("  Target power =", target_power, "\n")
cat("  Check: Power ≥ target?", power_final >= target_power, "\n\n")

# At preceding design (n_k = n_k_rounded)
se_rounded <- sqrt((lambda_t + lambda_c) * inflation_factor / (n_k_rounded * E))
z_stat_rounded <- abs(delta) / se_rounded
power_rounded <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha_2 - z_stat_rounded)

cat("Power verification at n_k =", n_k_rounded, "(PRECEDING):\n")
cat("  SE(λ̂_t - λ̂_c) =", se_rounded, "\n")
cat("  Z-statistic =", z_stat_rounded, "\n")
cat("  Power (two-sided) =", power_rounded, "\n")
cat("  Check: Power < target?", power_rounded < target_power, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 6: Compare to candidate answer
# ============================================================================

cat("=====   COMPARISON TO CANDIDATE ANSWER   =====\n\n")

cat("Candidate reported:\n")
cat("  Sample size: 4 clusters per arm\n")
cat("  Achieved power at n=4: 0.977284\n")
cat("  Power at n=3: 0.92922\n\n")

cat("Independent verification:\n")
cat("  Sample size: ", n_k_final, " clusters per arm\n", sep="")
cat("  Achieved power at n=", n_k_final, ": ", round(power_final, 6), "\n", sep="")
cat("  Power at n=", n_k_rounded, ": ", round(power_rounded, 6), "\n", sep="")

cat("\nNumerical agreement:\n")
cat("  Sample size match:", n_k_final == 4, "\n")
cat("  Final power match:", abs(power_final - 0.977284) < 0.000001, "\n")
cat("  Preceding power match:", abs(power_rounded - 0.92922) < 0.000001, "\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 7: Check formula correctness against methodology
# ============================================================================

cat("\n===== FORMULA VALIDATION =====\n\n")

cat("Field Trials Chapter 5.6.1 Cluster-Rate CV Approximation:\n")
cat("- Accounts for Poisson variation plus between-cluster overdispersion\n")
cat("- Variance inflation factor: 1 + CV²\n")
cat("- For rate λ in cluster with exposure E:\n")
cat("    Var(λ̂) = λ × (1 + CV²) / E\n")
cat("- Two-arm difference variance:\n")
cat("    Var(λ̂_t - λ̂_c) = (λ_t + λ_c) × (1 + CV²) / E\n")
cat("- Standard two-sample z-test formula applies at cluster level\n\n")

cat("Verification of inflation factor:\n")
cat("  CV² =", cv^2, "\n")
cat("  1 + CV² =", inflation_factor, "✓\n\n")

cat("Verification of effect size:\n")
cat("  Expected events per cluster:\n")
cat("    Treatment: λ_t × E =", lambda_t * E, "\n")
cat("    Control: λ_c × E =", lambda_c * E, "\n")
cat("  Difference: λ_t × E - λ_c × E =", (lambda_t - lambda_c) * E, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# Final structured output
# ============================================================================

library(jsonlite)

final_result <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = n_k_final, unit = "clusters_per_arm"),

alpha <- 0.05

# ============================================================================

cat("===============================================================\n\n")

events_per_cluster_t <- lambda_t * E
events_per_cluster_c <- lambda_c * E

cat("Expected events per cluster:\n")
cat("  Treatment cluster: λ_t × E =", lambda_t, "×", E, "=", events_per_cluster_t, "\n")
cat("  Control cluster: λ_c × E =", lambda_c, "×", E, "=", events_per_cluster_c, "\n")

cat("\nGuidance for Poisson-based approximations:\n")
cat("  - n ≥ 5 events per group: basic validity\n")
cat("  - n ≥ 10–25 events per group: good approximation\n")
cat("  - n ≥ 100+ events per group: excellent approximation\n")

if (events_per_cluster_t >= 10 && events_per_cluster_c >= 10) {
  cat("\n✓ Event counts (12.5 and 25) are in the borderline range [10, 25].\n")
  cat("  Normal approximation to Poisson is reasonable but not ideal.\n")
} else {
  cat("\n⚠ Event counts are low; normal approximation may be questionable.\n")
}

cat("\nImplications:\n")
cat("  - The sample size formula uses z-test (normal approximation)\n")
cat("  - With ~12.5 events in treatment and 25 in control, the normal\n")
cat("    approximation is acceptable but may introduce some error\n")
cat("  - Actual power via exact Poisson test might differ slightly\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# ASSUMPTION 2: Between-cluster CV specification and accuracy
# ============================================================================

cat("\nASSUMPTION 2: Between-Cluster Coefficient of Variation\n")
cat("========================================================\n\n")

cat("The formula assumes CV² =", cv^2, "captures all between-cluster variation.\n")
cat("Variance inflation factor: 1 + CV² =", 1 + cv^2, "\n\n")

cat("Interpretation of CV = 0.25:\n")
cat("  - This is a moderate amount of between-cluster heterogeneity\n")
cat("  - Implies cluster-level rates vary with SD = 0.25 × mean rate\n")
cat("  - For control rate λ_c = 0.010: cluster rates vary ~SD ≈ 0.0025\n")
cat("    (i.e., some clusters ~0.008, others ~0.012)\n")

cat("\nAssumptions embedded:\n")
cat("  1. CV applies equally to both treatment and control arms\n")
cat("  2. Between-cluster variation follows the (1 + CV²) model\n")
cat("  3. CV is constant across different exposure levels\n")
cat("  4. No interaction between treatment effect and cluster-level variation\n\n")

cat("If actual CV differs from 0.25, sample size requirements will change:\n")
cat("  - CV = 0.15: inflation factor = 1.0225 (smaller sample needed)\n")
cat("  - CV = 0.25: inflation factor = 1.0625 (as specified)\n")
cat("  - CV = 0.40: inflation factor = 1.16 (larger sample needed)\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# ASSUMPTION 3: Equal exposure across clusters
# ============================================================================

cat("ASSUMPTION 3: Equal Exposure Across Clusters\n")
cat("==============================================\n\n")

cat("Assumption: Each cluster has exactly E =", E, "child-weeks\n")
cat("This is a strong assumption requiring:\n")
cat("  1. Consistent follow-up time per child\n")
cat("  2. No differential dropout or loss-to-follow-up\n")
cat("  3. No variation in number of children per cluster\n\n")

cat("If actual exposure varies (e.g., ±10% variation):\n")
cat("  - Some clusters will have fewer events than expected\n")
cat("  - Effective information content will be reduced\n")
cat("  - Sample size may be insufficient in practice\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# ASSUMPTION 4: Formula derivation and null hypothesis
# ============================================================================

cat("ASSUMPTION 4: Rate Difference as Estimand\n")
cat("==========================================\n\n")

cat("The formula tests the null hypothesis:\n")
cat("  H₀: λ_t = λ_c\n")
cat("  H₁: λ_t ≠ λ_c (two-sided)\n\n")

cat("Effect size (rate difference):\n")
cat("  δ = λ_t - λ_c =", lambda_t - lambda_c, "per child-week\n")
cat("  Relative reduction: (λ_c - λ_t) / λ_c =", 
    (lambda_c - lambda_t) / lambda_c * 100, "%\n\n")

cat("This is a 50% reduction in event rate.\n")
cat("The sample size formula is sensitive to the effect size;\n")
cat("if actual effect differs from this assumption, power will change.\n\n")

# ============================================================================

cat("==============================================\n\n")

cat("Continuous solution: n_k = 2.679 clusters per arm\n")
cat("Rounded up: n_k = 3 clusters per arm\n")
cat("With additive correction: n_k = 4 clusters per arm\n\n")

cat("The one-cluster correction is:\n")
cat("  1. Conservative (adds 'insurance' for rounding)\n")
cat("  2. Simple to implement\n")
cat("  3. Assumes equal information gain from each cluster\n")
cat("  4. May overestimate for very small initial sample sizes\n\n")

cat("  - This provides substantial margin above target\n\n")

cat("  - n_k = 4 independent clusters per arm (8 total)\n")
cat("  - Clusters are the unit of randomization\n")
cat("  - Children within a cluster are NOT independent\n")
cat("    (this is implicitly handled via the CV inflation factor)\n\n")

cat("  - The formula assumes the between-cluster CV properly accounts\n")
cat("    for within-cluster correlation\n")
cat("  - If children are highly correlated within clusters,\n")
cat("    the actual power may be lower than calculated\n")
cat("  - The (1 + CV²) factor is an approximation that works well\n")
cat("    when CV is not too large\n\n")

cat("==============================================\n\n")

cat("  - With equal allocation (1:1), power is symmetric\n")

cat("  ✓ Cluster-randomized design with independent clusters\n")
cat("  ✓ Two-sided test at α = 0.05 (specified)\n")
cat("  ⚠ Event counts (12.5–25) adequate for normal approximation\n")

cat("  - This provides margin for minor deviations in assumptions\n")

# Final cross-check: verify power calculations using alternative formulation
# and ensure consistency of the test statistic

cat("===== POWER CALCULATION CROSS-CHECK =====\n\n")

# Parameters
lambda_t <- 0.005
lambda_c <- 0.010
E <- 2500
cv <- 0.25
alpha <- 0.05
n_final <- 4
n_preceding <- 3

z_alpha_2 <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)

cat("Parameters:\n")
cat("  λ_t =", lambda_t, ", λ_c =", lambda_c, "\n")
cat("  E =", E, ", CV =", cv, "\n")
cat("  α =", alpha, "(two-sided), z_{α/2} =", z_alpha_2, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# Method 1: Using rate difference directly
# ============================================================================

cat("METHOD 1: Rate Difference Test\n")
cat("================================\n\n")

delta <- lambda_t - lambda_c
inflation <- 1 + cv^2

# Standard error of rate difference at H1 with n clusters per arm
se_rate_1 <- sqrt((lambda_t + lambda_c) * inflation / (n_final * E))

# Test statistic (absolute value of effect divided by SE)
z_stat_1 <- abs(delta) / se_rate_1

# Power for two-sided test: P(|Z| > z_α/2 | H1)
# = 1 - P(|Z| ≤ z_α/2 | H1)
# = 1 - [Φ(z_α/2 - z_stat) - Φ(-z_α/2 - z_stat)]
# ≈ 1 - Φ(z_α/2 - z_stat) for large z_stat
# = Φ(z_stat - z_α/2)

power_1_final <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha_2 - z_stat_1)

cat("At n =", n_final, "clusters per arm:\n")
cat("  SE(λ̂_t - λ̂_c) = sqrt{(", lambda_t, "+", lambda_c, ") × ", 
    inflation, "/ (", n_final, "×", E, ")}\n")
cat("                =", se_rate_1, "\n")
cat("  Z-statistic = |", delta, "| /", se_rate_1, "=", z_stat_1, "\n")
cat("  Power = 1 - Φ(", z_alpha_2, "-", z_stat_1, ")\n")
cat("        = 1 - Φ(", z_alpha_2 - z_stat_1, ")\n")
cat("        =", power_1_final, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# Method 2: Using event difference (alternative formulation)
# ============================================================================

cat("METHOD 2: Event Count Difference Test\n")
cat("======================================\n\n")

m_t <- lambda_t * E  # expected events in treatment cluster
m_c <- lambda_c * E  # expected events in control cluster
delta_m <- m_t - m_c # event difference per cluster

# Variance of event difference with between-cluster inflation
# Var(m_t) = m_t * (1 + CV²)
# Var(m_c) = m_c * (1 + CV²)
# For n clusters, averaging gives variance:
var_delta_m <- (m_t + m_c) * inflation / n_final

se_event_diff <- sqrt(var_delta_m)

# Test statistic
z_stat_2 <- abs(delta_m) / se_event_diff

# Power
power_2_final <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha_2 - z_stat_2)

cat("At n =", n_final, "clusters per arm:\n")
cat("  Expected events: λ_t × E =", m_t, ", λ_c × E =", m_c, "\n")
cat("  Event difference: δ_m =", delta_m, "\n")
cat("  SE(m̂_t - m̂_c) = sqrt{(", m_t, "+", m_c, ") × ", 
    inflation, "/ ", n_final, "}\n")
cat("                =", se_event_diff, "\n")
cat("  Z-statistic =", z_stat_2, "\n")
cat("  Power =", power_2_final, "\n\n")

# Note: These should give the same test statistic
cat("Consistency check:\n")
cat("  Method 1 Z-statistic:", z_stat_1, "\n")
cat("  Method 2 Z-statistic:", z_stat_2, "\n")
cat("  Difference:", abs(z_stat_1 - z_stat_2), "\n")
cat("  Match:", abs(z_stat_1 - z_stat_2) < 1e-10, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# Preceding design (n = 3)
# ============================================================================

cat("PRECEDING DESIGN: n =", n_preceding, "clusters per arm\n")
cat("=====================================================\n\n")

se_rate_prec <- sqrt((lambda_t + lambda_c) * inflation / (n_preceding * E))
z_stat_prec <- abs(delta) / se_rate_prec
power_prec <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha_2 - z_stat_prec)

cat("  SE(λ̂_t - λ̂_c) =", se_rate_prec, "\n")
cat("  Z-statistic =", z_stat_prec, "\n")
cat("  Power =", power_prec, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# Summary table
# ============================================================================

cat("SUMMARY TABLE\n")
cat("==============\n\n")

results_df <- data.frame(
  Design = c(paste("n = ", n_preceding, " (preceding)", sep=""),
             paste("n = ", n_final, " (final)", sep="")),
  SE = c(se_rate_prec, se_rate_1),
  Z_stat = c(z_stat_prec, z_stat_1),
  Power = c(power_prec, power_1_final),
  Meets_90pct = c(
    ifelse(power_prec >= 0.90, "YES", "NO"),
    ifelse(power_1_final >= 0.90, "YES", "NO")
  )
)

print(results_df)

cat("\n\nRounding and correction logic:\n")
cat("  Continuous n_k = 2.679 clusters per arm\n")
cat("  ↓ ceiling(2.679) = 3\n")
cat("  ↓ +1 for additive correction = 4\n\n")

cat("Design selection:\n")
cat("  n = 3 clusters per arm achieves", round(power_prec, 4), "power\n")
cat("    - Exceeds 90% target\n")
cat("    - But only by", round((power_prec - 0.90) * 100, 2), "percentage points\n\n")

cat("  n = 4 clusters per arm achieves", round(power_1_final, 4), "power\n")
cat("    - Well above 90% target\n")
cat("    - Margin:", round((power_1_final - 0.90) * 100, 2), "percentage points\n\n")

cat("against minor deviations in assumptions.\n\n")

# ============================================================================

cat("FINAL VALIDATION\n")
cat("=================\n\n")

cat("Candidate answer claims:\n")
cat("  Sample size: 4 clusters per arm ✓\n")
cat("  Power at n=4: 0.977284\n")
cat("  Power at n=3: 0.92922\n\n")

# Cluster-rate coefficient-of-variation approximation
# Field Trials of Health Interventions, Chapter 5, Section 6.1
# With additive one-cluster correction

# Input parameters
treatment_rate <- 0.005        # per child-week
control_rate <- 0.010          # per child-week
exposure_per_cluster <- 2500   # child-weeks per cluster
cv <- 0.25                     # between-cluster coefficient of variation
alpha <- 0.05                  # significance level, two-sided
target_power <- 0.90           # target power
allocation_ratio <- 1          # equal allocation (1:1)

# Two-sided test critical value
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)

# Power critical value
z_power <- qnorm(target_power)

# Rate difference (H0: lambda_t = lambda_c)
lambda_t <- treatment_rate
lambda_c <- control_rate
delta <- lambda_t - lambda_c

cat("Input Parameters:\n")
cat("Treatment rate (λ_t):", lambda_t, "per child-week\n")
cat("Control rate (λ_c):", lambda_c, "per child-week\n")
cat("Rate difference (δ):", delta, "per child-week\n")
cat("Between-cluster CV:", cv, "\n")
cat("Exposure per cluster:", exposure_per_cluster, "child-weeks\n")
cat("Significance level (two-sided):", alpha, "\n")
cat("Target power:", target_power, "\n")
cat("z_α/2:", z_alpha, "\n")
cat("z_power:", z_power, "\n\n")

# Under H0, both arms have rate λ_c (null hypothesis of no difference)
# Expected number of events per cluster under H0
m0 <- exposure_per_cluster * lambda_c

# Under H1, treatment arm has rate λ_t, control arm has rate λ_c
m_t <- exposure_per_cluster * lambda_t  # expected events in treatment arm
m_c <- exposure_per_cluster * lambda_c  # expected events in control arm

cat("Expected events per cluster under H0 (both arms):", m0, "\n")
cat("Expected events in treatment cluster:", m_t, "\n")
cat("Expected events in control cluster:", m_c, "\n\n")

# Variance inflation factor due to between-cluster variation
# var = E[m] * (1 + CV²) where var is cluster-level variance
inflation_factor <- 1 + cv^2

cat("Variance inflation factor (1 + CV²):", inflation_factor, "\n\n")

# Cluster-level variance under H0 (null)
# For Poisson with overdispersion: var = m * (1 + CV²)
var_null <- m0 * inflation_factor

# Cluster-level variance under H1 (alternative)
# var_t = m_t * (1 + CV²)
# var_c = m_c * (1 + CV²)
var_treatment <- m_t * inflation_factor
var_control <- m_c * inflation_factor

# For two-sided test, pooled variance (assuming equal allocation)
var_pooled_h1 <- (var_treatment + var_control) / 2

cat("Variance under H0 (both arms):", var_null, "\n")
cat("Variance in treatment arm under H1:", var_treatment, "\n")
cat("Variance in control arm under H1:", var_control, "\n")
cat("Pooled variance under H1:", var_pooled_h1, "\n\n")

# Expected rate difference: δ = λ_t - λ_c
expected_delta <- lambda_t - lambda_c

# For cluster-level analysis, the expected difference per cluster is:
expected_cluster_difference <- exposure_per_cluster * expected_delta

cat("Expected cluster-level rate difference:", expected_delta, "per child-week\n")
cat("Expected event difference per cluster:", expected_cluster_difference, "\n\n")

# Number of clusters per arm (before rounding and correction)
# Using two-sample z-test for difference of means formula:
# n = (z_α/2 + z_β)² * (var_null / (treatment_effect)²)
# 
# However, for cluster-level analysis with overdispersion:
# The variance structure is more complex. The standard formula for 
# cluster-randomized trials is:
#
# n_k = [(z_α/2 + z_β)² * σ²] / effect²
#
# where effect is cluster-level rate difference
# σ² is the pooled variance

# Under the CV approximation, we use:
# var of difference = var_treatment + var_control (for independent clusters)
# For each arm: variance of (λ̂_t - λ̂_c) needs the sum of variances
# 
# Standard two-sample cluster-level formula:
# n_k = [(z_α/2 + z_β)² * (var_t + var_c)] / (effect²)
#
# where effect = m_t - m_c (cluster-level difference)

effect_cluster <- m_t - m_c  # difference in expected events per cluster
effect_cluster_rate <- expected_delta  # difference in rates

cat("Effect (cluster event difference):", effect_cluster, "\n")
cat("Effect (rate difference):", effect_cluster_rate, "per child-week\n\n")

# Sample size calculation
# For testing difference in Poisson rates with cluster structure:
# n_k = (z_α/2 + z_β)² * (var_null * 2) / (effect²)
# 
# With variance inflation and equal allocation:
n_k_formula <- (z_alpha + z_power)^2 * (var_treatment + var_control) / (effect_cluster^2)

cat("Sample size formula calculation:\n")
cat("  Numerator: (z_α/2 + z_β)² * (var_t + var_c)\n")
cat("           = (", z_alpha, "+", z_power, ")² * (", var_treatment, "+", var_control, ")\n")
cat("           = ", (z_alpha + z_power)^2, "* ", (var_treatment + var_control), "\n")
cat("           = ", (z_alpha + z_power)^2 * (var_treatment + var_control), "\n")
cat("  Denominator: effect² = ", effect_cluster, "² =", effect_cluster^2, "\n")
cat("  n_k (continuous) = ", n_k_formula, "\n\n")

# Additive one-cluster correction
# Add 1 cluster to each arm for conservative coverage
n_k_continuous <- n_k_formula
n_k_rounded <- ceiling(n_k_continuous)
n_k_with_correction <- n_k_rounded + 1

cat("Rounding and correction:\n")
cat("  n_k continuous =", n_k_continuous, "\n")
cat("  n_k rounded up =", n_k_rounded, "\n")
cat("  n_k with one-cluster correction = ", n_k_rounded, "+ 1 =", n_k_with_correction, "\n\n")

# Verification: calculate achieved power at final sample size
# Power = P(Z > z_crit | H1), where Z is test statistic under H1

# Test statistic: Z = (λ̂_t - λ̂_c) / SE(λ̂_t - λ̂_c)
# Under H1 (with n_k clusters per arm):
# E[λ̂_t] = λ_t, E[λ̂_c] = λ_c
# Var[λ̂_t] = var_treatment / n_k
# Var[λ̂_c] = var_control / n_k
# SE² = var_treatment/n_k + var_control/n_k

se_squared_h1 <- (var_treatment + var_control) / n_k_with_correction
se_h1 <- sqrt(se_squared_h1)

# Non-centrality parameter
ncp <- (m_t - m_c) / se_h1

# Achieved power
achieved_power <- pnorm(ncp - z_alpha) + pnorm(-ncp - z_alpha)
# For one-sided upper tail (or two-sided):
achieved_power_twosided <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha - ncp) + pnorm(-z_alpha - ncp)
achieved_power_twosided_correct <- pnorm(ncp - z_alpha) + pnorm(-ncp - z_alpha)

achieved_power <- 1 - pnorm(z_alpha - ncp)

cat("Verification at n_k =", n_k_with_correction, "clusters per arm:\n")
cat("  SE under H1:", se_h1, "\n")
cat("  Effect size (cluster events):", m_t - m_c, "\n")
cat("  Non-centrality parameter:", ncp, "\n")
cat("  Achieved power (two-sided):", achieved_power, "\n")
cat("  Target power:", target_power, "\n\n")

# Also verify at the rounded but uncorrected sample size
se_squared_h1_rounded <- (var_treatment + var_control) / n_k_rounded
se_h1_rounded <- sqrt(se_squared_h1_rounded)
ncp_rounded <- (m_t - m_c) / se_h1_rounded

cat("Verification at n_k =", n_k_rounded, "clusters per arm (before correction):\n")
cat("  Achieved power (two-sided):", achieved_power_rounded, "\n\n")

# Final result
cat("=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "\n")
cat("FINAL RESULT\n")
cat("=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "=" %+% "\n")
cat("Sample size (clusters per arm):", n_k_with_correction, "\n")
cat("Method: cluster_rate_cv with additive one-cluster correction\n")
cat("Achieved power at n_k =", n_k_with_correction, ":", achieved_power, "\n")
cat("Power at n_k =", n_k_rounded, ":", achieved_power_rounded, "\n")

  method = "cluster_rate_cv",
  achieved_power = achieved_power,
